contracts.ExactSemanticDisposition: Exact target bytes/version/scope, actual role assignment and observed owner response; pending request never accepted.
contracts.CarrierCompatibility: Bind actual descriptor/schema/generator/admission; separate retained historical reads, new v2 writes, reviewed upgrades and refused downcasts.
contracts.DefinitionRegistryV2Proposal: Per-entry representation contracts plus stable identity/current lookup and exact predecessor/postimage bindings; separately reviewed registry carrier successor.
contracts.WorkspaceExecutionContext: Durable workspace selection, actual subject scope, exact runtime/host/custody/store and source/HEAD; Product-only review needs no invented Project.
contracts.CreationRoute: Explicit current compiled Entry and existing native validation/writer; preparation remains unsigned.
contracts.PublicationTransaction: Exact old registry/index/source and proposed postimages, semantic disposition, permission and native commit receipt; CAS and recovery, never Git-as-semantic-admission.
contracts.JoinJournal: Stable operation id, source vector, exact approvals/targets, phase, native transaction and canonical publication receipts; unknown outcomes require inspection.
contracts.ImpactClosure: Exact reverse-dependency and registered-consumer closure with completeness/truncation evidence and reviewed successor/withdraw effects.
contracts.ConstructionGate: Seven exact stages, six adjacent handoffs, mapped obligations, language/native closure and inherited construction compatibility. Entry coverage is executable check specifications; output manifests and independent conformance are completion evidence.

trusted_observation_boundary: DTO flags and hashes do not authenticate themselves. Future selected ports independently read bytes, check schema/fidelity/crypto/roles/HEAD and return exact subject-bound receipts. Candidate fixture facts never supply real authority. No port is implemented or wired by this design.
